diagnosis: Fetch fails with `TRAP: cpu trap asserted` and `FAIL 0xdead` instead of clean NOP progress. `mem_rdata_latched_noshuffle` at picorv32.v:384 selects `mem_rdata_q` when `mem_xfer` is true and live `mem_rdata` when idle, which is inverted. This feeds stale/previous-cycle data into `mem_rdata_latched` (picorv32.v:386-388) causing illegal decode and trap.
reason: Diagram shows the fetch rdata path through mem_rdata_q mux into decode/trap, confirming the inverted-select explains the TRAP/FAIL and the swap fixes it.
